newsitem.title: ITALY: CYCLING-CIPOLLINI SNATCHES FOURTH GIRO STAGE WIN.
newsitem.headline: CYCLING-CIPOLLINI SNATCHES FOURTH GIRO STAGE WIN.

text.p: Mario Cipollini equalled his personal record of four stage wins in a Giro d'Italia when he snatched the 10th stage by centimetres on Monday.
Endrio Leoni closed the gap in the final metres of the 195 kms from Castrovillari but had to settle for second place with Fabio Baldato third to complete an Italian 1-2-3.

Leoni now has two second and three third placings but for Cipollini this was his 20th Giro success, repeating his four stage wins in 1992 and putting the Tuscan among the 12 most successful stage-winners in the 80 Giro years.

With the pack finishing together, Pavel Tonkov of Russia retained his 41-second lead over Frenchman Luc Leblanc as the riders prepared to fly north for Tuesday's rest day at the Tyrrhenian resort of Camaiore.
